newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos says North Korean defector in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Ramos says North Korean defector in Philippines.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday that North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop was in the Philippines, the first official admission by Manila that Pyongyang's top ideologue was in the country.

Ramos told his weekly news weekly news conference that "arrangements for Mr Hwang's temporary stay in our country have been worked out by responsible agencies of our government after consultations with concerned countries".
"The Philippines decided to allow the temporary stay of Mr Hwang only for as long as necessary and as short as possible."
Hwang arrived at nearby Clark air base on Tuesday from China. He had been marooned in South Korea's embassy in Beijing since seeking asylum there on February 12.
His journey from Seoul's Beijing mission to the Philippines was shrouded in secrecy.
